description: Pressure increases error and rework which increases workload and future pressure
Recovery rebuilds capacity and reduces overload
Reliable service builds trust which increases participation and useful feedback
Messaging without repair can deepen distrust and reduce future message effectiveness
Added road capacity lowers travel time which increases demand and restores congestion
Automated decisions create errors and appeal burden which increases system workload
Documentation rules increase burden and appeals which increase administrative workload
Accessible processes improve trust and completion which improves system feedback
